description.zh: 永久删除一个项目（含其对话历史与全部产物文件，不可恢复）。用户明确要求删除某个项目时使用；按项目名或 id 定位，多个同名时返回列表让用户确认。
description.en: Permanently delete a project (including its conversation history and all artifact files; not recoverable). Use when the user explicitly asks to delete a project; locate it by name or id, and list candidates when several match.

name.description: 要删除的项目名称（或项目 id）
name (or id) of the project to delete
